## Guidance

Исполнитель: Sol (codex gpt-6.1-sol, implementation/medium) — механика по готовым таблицам.

| role_id | title | tools fs/shell/net/plan_api | write_authority | result_shape | model_class_min | skills | forbidden_inputs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| context-scout | Context scout | read / read_only / none / none | none | context-map | economy | [] | lifecycle_instructions, report_api, plan_write |
| executor | Executor | write / full / none / none | code_scope | stage-report | implementation | [] | lifecycle_instructions, report_api, plan_write |
| bounded-implementer | Bounded implementer | write / full / none / none | code_scope | stage-report | economy | [] | lifecycle_instructions, report_api, plan_write |
| reviewer | Reviewer | read / read_only / none / none | none | review-findings | implementation | `quality:code-review` (required true, why "review method for code diffs"), `quality:artifact-review` (required false, why "review method for plans and docs") | lifecycle_instructions, report_api, plan_write |
| registrar | Registrar | read / full / none / write | plan | registration-receipt | economy | [] | [] |

`instructions`: `[{"path": "packages/orch/roles/<role_id>.md", "purpose": "canonical role text", "sha256": <sha256 файла>}]`.
`description`: первая строка «You do» из соответствующего `.md`.
`agent_pack_roles`: executor и bounded-implementer — все записи `roles.json` с `role_id == "slice-builder"`; reviewer — все с `role_id == "reviewer"`; остальные — `[]`. Точный список (проверено 2026-10-05; тест сверяет с roles.json): slice-builder — packs `backend-laravel`, `dart-flutter`, `laravel-package`, `node-frontend`, `python-backend`; reviewer — те же 5 packs.

Тест: каждый manifest валиден (`orch.contracts.validate`); `role_id` == имя файла; файлы инструкций существуют и sha256 совпадает; каждая запись agent_pack_roles существует в roles.json (файл читается по пути `Path(__file__).parents[3] / "harness/configs/common/agent-packs/roles.json"`, skipUnless существует).
